_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Make this game model printable as a 100 mm figure.
My slicer says the STL is non-manifold, can you fix it?

expectations: the polywright-print skill is not invoked (polywright-finish)

evals.prompt: Which filament is best for outdoor use?
expectations: the polywright-print skill is not invoked (materials advice, not the model)

evals.prompt: Make tests/fixtures/two.glb printable at 40 mm and check it for FDM.
expectations: ran pw.py printable and check (tool calls) and reported watertight

evals.prompt: How thin can walls be on a 0.4 mm nozzle?
expectations: about 0.9 mm minimum (two perimeters), 1.2 to 1.6 mm for structure
regex on the answer: (?i)0\.9|two perimeters|2 perimeters
